caption: The video captures a fire performer from behind on a festival stage beneath a blue-lit tensile canopy, a dense crowd of raised hands and phone lights filling the background while monitors, speakers and cables line the floor. She holds a long fire staff with flames at both ends, the staff held horizontally across her upper back as she stands upright. The staff tilts and rotates, one end swinging downward and the other rising through a diagonal toward a near-vertical position overhead. Her torso and hips turn with it, stance widening and knees bending as she spins the staff around her body and above her head, flame plumes sweeping past her shoulders. Her position shifts as her profile moves from a square back-to-camera pose to a more angled, crouched stance. The rotation remains underway, the overhead flames flaring against the canopy.
